headline: Mixed signals. Only the highest-conviction setups. Reduce size.

coach_note:
Mixed signals. Pradeep's rule: when the market is not giving you a clear edge, reduce your size and be selective. Don't force trades.
Qullamaggie: 'If there are no good setups, you lose your confidence... Sometimes it takes a few weeks or a few months, but they always come back.'
Manas Arora: 'A narrow rally with T2108 above 60 but quarter breadth below 500 is a warning, not an opportunity.'
Jim Loehr: 'The best athletes know when to be aggressive and when to be patient. Right now, patience is your edge.'
mental_anchor: Patience is a position. The market will give you clarity — wait for it.
mental_reset:
Take 60 seconds before you look at any charts.
Breathe in — 4 counts. Hold — 2. Out — 6. Repeat three times.
The market is mixed. That's okay. Your job is not to trade every day.
Your job is to trade when the odds are in your favor.
Today, be selective. Be patient. Be disciplined.
